protocol.weighting: equal scene, then equal event within scene
protocol.delta_direction: ablation minus full model; positive Brier means removing the factor hurts
protocol.no_event_scope: event loss weight zero; fixed validation event-based checkpoint selection is retained
protocol.no_global_scope: decoder global factors disabled; encoder global context and local correlation are retained

claim_boundary: All seeds are reported on reused validation; intervals are descriptive within-seed scene bootstraps, not multiplicity-adjusted confirmation or final test claims.
